title: New Deck & Roof — Permit Set
scope: New deck and roof structure designed and detailed for permit and construction.
description: Full structural design and engineering calculations for a elevated residential deck with a timber roof cover. Included post sizing, ledger attachment verification, joist span calculations, and lateral bracing details for municipal building permit approval in Parker, CO.

title: Replacement Steel Deck
scope: Steel deck replacement engineered and detailed for permit and construction.
description: Engineered steel framing replacement deck for high snow-load mountain terrain in Evergreen, CO. Performed structural capacity calculations for structural tubing columns, steel beams, and cantilevered joists, accompanied by stamped permit sheets.

title: Enclosed Deck Structure
scope: Enclosed deck structure designed with stamped engineering drawings for permit.
description: Comprehensive structural analysis for a multi-season enclosed deck addition. Calculated wind load resistance, roof snow loads, and foundation footing sizes for soft soils in the El Paso County jurisdiction.

title: Patio Cover & Garage Extension
scope: New patio cover and garage extension engineered for permit and construction.
description: Engineered a custom patio cover attached to an existing residential structure along with a detached garage extension. Verified tie-in connections, header beam capacities, and footing moment resistance.

title: Aadheshwor Mandir — DPR
scope: Detailed Project Report for temple construction and landscaping works, including cost estimation and sanitary design.
client: Office of the Municipal Executive, Nagarjun
description: Prepared the comprehensive Detailed Project Report (DPR) for temple development. Conducted quantity surveying, rate analysis using municipal normative rates, sanitary system layout, and site retaining wall design.

title: Kauretar Sports Field — Masterplan
scope: Masterplan preparation for a municipal sports field, with detailed cost estimation.
client: Office of the Municipal Executive, Bhanu
description: Masterplanned a municipal multi-purpose sports complex including earthwork cut/fill estimation, site drainage design, retaining structures, and complete Bill of Quantities (BoQ).

title: Kedareswor Mandir (Seto Shivalinga) — DPR
scope: Consultancy services preparing the DPR, with cost estimation and sanitary design and drawing.
description: Detailed engineering survey, structural integrity report, sanitary drainage layout, and cost estimation for cultural site restoration in Ward 30 of Kathmandu Metropolitan City.

title: Ground Reservoir Tank & Office Building
scope: Detailed engineering design of a ground reservoir tank (GRVT) and office building.
client: Shree Lalgadh Water Supply & Sanitation Users' Committee
codes: IS 3370 (Concrete Structures for Storage of Liquids)
